reason: Authored and verified the promised claim: Let kappa be an infinite regular cardinal and P a nonempty forcing preorder, with stronger conditions smaller. P is kappa-closed when every descending sequence of length gamma<kappa has a common lower bound; P is kappa-distributive when the intersection of every gamma<kappa dense open subsets of P is dense; and P is kappa-cc when every antichain has cardinality below kappa. Thus ccc is aleph_1-cc, while countably closed (sigma-closed) means aleph_1-closed, not omega-closed.
